metadata.name: Performance Core
metadata.description: Disables disk prefetching and legacy background helpers that slow SSD based gaming rigs.

tweaks.name: SysMain Service
tweaks.defaultBehavior: SysMain (formerly Superfetch) watches app usage and preloads data into RAM to improve launch times, which can consume memory and disk IO on gaming setups with SSDs.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Stops SysMain and sets the startup type to Disabled so Windows leaves disks alone during gaming sessions.
tweaks.notes: Skip this tweak on machines that still rely on HDDs for most games.

tweaks.name: Boot Persistence
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Windows Update can silently reset service startup types after patches, undoing performance tweaks without any notification.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Registers a startup scheduled task under \WGE\ that re-applies this performance preset at every boot. Keeps SysMain and other services disabled even after Windows Update meddles with them.
tweaks.notes: Visible in Task Scheduler under \WGE\. If you move the dist folder after applying, re-run Apply to update the task's script path.
